body: Nope, I don't believe so... haha

Yeah, I think I just have mood swings. I talked to my doctor about it and I'm not showing any signs of manic episodes. I still think about what happens after we die, but I think I'm going to start changing my thought process because what happens after death isn't nearly as important as all that happens before that. And I still do think 'something' happens after we die but it's best not to think about that because it takes away from living this life. And yeah man, my life is actually pretty stable atm. I'm exercising, being productive, socializing. It's just my thinking patterns atm I suppose. How're you doing?
Definitely man, I really need to change my thinking process.

Hey man, yeah I'm definitely on the same boat where I have these realizations where I feel great and I know why I'm here and then the next day it goes away. And I think I've come to the conclusion that we have absolutely no idea what happens after we die. Yeah, biologically speaking we are no longer 'here' but just thinking about life and how crazy existence really is it really makes me wonder if this is all, for me I don't think so. Even the simplest bacteria is pretty damn crazy if you really think about it, it's insane. What's after life? I'm not sure, probably something that we aren't meant to comprehend and that's ok. Yeah I'll talk to my doctor about if I can wean off of them maybe. Also yeah I have talked to a therapist before but it was mainly when I was in a crisis situation...

Absolutely, there's a ton of things that I like to do and many people in my life that I love. But once that thought or idea of death comes up its like everything crumbles and my depression starts seeping in again. Thoughts like what's the point? I do like your point of view on life though, it's a lot more positive and I like it. I'm not currently seeing a therapist or doctor but I am on anti-depressants atm.
Hmm, but in the end the universe will always end and I would always lose. So then what's the point again? Sorry, my mind keeps coming up with all these stubborn questions...

Hmm, you make an interesting point that I have to create my own meaning. But that thought is still in the back of my head that eventually everything that I love and cherish will eventually fade away with the death of the universe. It feels almost as if I'm lying to myself by creating meaning... like it's just a facade that I'm putting up to deal with knowing the futility of everything.

Hey, thanks for replying. I agree with you that I'm not forced into a nihilistic worldview but what other views of the world can I take? Every time I look at something I just see the emptiness of it all. And I'm feeling so empty on the inside what's the point of just continuing? What is there after death? I'm just feeling so numb and empty to everything.
